product.name: Project Execution Planner
product.subtitle: Undated · Run It, Then Close It Properly

positioning.unit_of_planning: the project week, and the closure at the end
positioning.scope: running a project day to day and closing it formally
positioning.one_line: For the phase after the kick-off meeting: a responsibility matrix, a weekly and daily cadence, time blocking that protects project work from reactive work, and a closure checklist that stops finished projects leaking cost.

primary: Freelancers and consultants running client projects
Anyone inheriting a project already scoped by someone else

differentiators: Responsibility Matrix (RACI) with a one-name-accountable rule
Weekly Project Planner and Daily Task Planner — the plan meets an actual calendar
Time Blocking, because project work loses every contest with reactive work
Project Closure Checklist covering access revocation, invoicing and archiving
Final Project Review separating what happened from what everyone remembers
Definition pages deliberately held to one page each
Four sizes, verified page and link parity

differs_from.003-project-planner: SEVERE OVERLAP — SAME CATEGORY, AND THE THINNEST DISTINCTION IN THE CATALOGUE. 04 defines and controls a project: charter, scope, requirements, WBS, gantt, sprint, kanban, budget, expenses, deliverables, communication plan. This product runs and closes one: RACI, weekly and daily cadence, time blocking, closure checklist, final review. Only six of this product's sections are genuinely absent from 04, and three of those are generic execution pages. Merging the two is the stronger commercial option.

catalogue_warning: Fourth shadow product built after an overlap was flagged. The differentiating axis is materially weaker than for 10-meeting-planner-pro or 11-goal-achievement-planner. Recommendation: merge 04 and this into one larger Project Planner rather than listing both.

compatibility.print: 100% scale, no bleed required, 100–120 gsm recommended
